annotations.end_anchor: Let us now proceed to the Book of Enoch.
annotations.note: Translator's (Lumpkin's) general INTRODUCTION/commentary for the whole volume (~24K chars): non-canonical books in the Bible, transmission history of Enoch (Bruce/Laurence/Charles/Qumran), and — critically — the description of 1 Enoch's 'five distinct sections' as CHAPTER RANGES ('(1 Enoch 1-36) - The Book of Watchers', etc.). The EPUB nav has a single 'Introduction' node directly above '1 Enoch'; it doubles as 1 Enoch's introduction (closes with 'Let us now proceed to the Book of Enoch.'). NOT detected as introduction — detector folds it into the body. TYPE JUDGMENT: introduction (translator's editorial apparatus) over commentary; the heading is literally 'INTRODUCTION'.

annotations.count_cue: 3 constituent books bound as one volume: 1 Enoch (Ethiopic), 2 Enoch (Slavonic), 3 Enoch (Hebrew). Confirmed by the TOC (4 nav entries: Introduction + the 3 books) and by the trailing Document Outline ('1 Enoch' / '2 Enoch' / '3 Enoch' top-level nodes). Each book carries its own title heading and (for 2 & 3 Enoch) its own introduction. The current detector does NOT segment at the book level — it emits one body + 221 flat chapters with no book containers.

annotations.count_cue: 228 chapters across the 3 books = 108 (1 Enoch) + 68 (2 Enoch) + 52 (3 Enoch). 1 ENOCH = 108 (canonical), all present and verified: 106 of 108 headings match /[\[I]Chapter (N|roman I)[\]\}]/ (the bracket form '[Chapter N]'); the 2 'missing' from a strict scan are OCR-corrupted brackets — ch1 '[Chapter I}', ch35 '[Chapter 35J', ch36 '[Chapter 361', ch85/105/106 'IChapter N]' — individually verified present. 2 ENOCH = 68 (canonical): standalone 'Chapter N' headings 1-68; a strict scan returns 70 line matches = 68 headings + 2 inline cross-references to 'Chapter 53' inside the commentary (the missing 'Chapter 5' is a real heading present in body). 3 ENOCH = 52 printed 'CHAPTER N' headings (Odeberg edition): chapters I,2-4,6-7,9-47 (5 & 8 are GENUINELY ABSENT in Odeberg's reconstruction) PLUS the multi-part chapters 15+15B, 22+22B+22C, and 48A/48B/48C/48D — 52 standalone '\n\nCHAPTER ...' headings in the body. EDITIONS VARY; counts cross-checked against canon (1En 108, 2En 68, 3En 48-base) and verified programmatically against THIS text. Detector finds 221 flat chapters (no book grouping); 228 is the true book-aware total.

annotations.note: PRIMARY structure. Three distinct chapter-heading formats by book — 1 Enoch '[Chapter N]' (bracketed, several OCR-corrupted), 2 Enoch 'Chapter N' (title-case, no brackets), 3 Enoch 'CHAPTER N' (uppercase, with A/B/C/D sub-parts). Verse-level numbering inside chapters is the masked body. The body also interleaves italic Bible cross-references (GEN/JUD/MAT/HEB ...) and parenthetical '(Author's note: ...)' glosses — not separately segmented here.

Trailing EPUB navigation map exported as text ('Document Outline': Front Cover / Title / ISBN / Contents / Introduction / 1 Enoch / 2 Enoch / 3 Enoch / Back Cover). Non-authorial navigational matter at the very end of the stream; this is also the authoritative confirmation of the 3-book + general-introduction top-level structure.
